title: The Edtech That Chose to Close and Return Its Investors' Money
conflicts: Closure date is February 2025, not the slate's 2024. The return-of-capital claim rests on Edukoya's own email to stakeholders (quoted by Nairametrics, BusinessDay, Technext, Techpoint); no personally signed statement by Ogundeyi was found in a loadable source, so the words are attributed to the company's statement. Amount returned undisclosed everywhere. Staff cuts: former employees told TechCabal (2022) most staff were let go; the company said four after a performance review; both given. Her 2021 quotes are worded differently in 2025 reprints; TechCrunch's original used.
notes: Launch Base Africa's balance-sheet speculation is left out (outlet's inference, not a court, regulator or founder finding). Techpoint Africa blocks the verifier but is cited as the original report; its details are also in loadable sources (Launch Base Africa, CIO Africa).
